justification.description: The source attempts to group stabilizer states by their signed intersection with M and identify those classes with maximal closed commuting subsets. The stated proof has a gap because an arbitrary stabilizer intersection need not be maximal.

The claim itself holds the measurement window M fixed. The source proof starts from a full-state stabilizer pseudomixture. Minimizing its l1 norm can yield only an upper bound by the full RoM, not by the reduced optimum. A Clifford can rotate an unmeasured Bloch component into the fixed window and increase the visible functional.
Choose a binary-symplectic independent basis of S. Relation syndromes force and are forced by the unique extension f(P)=eta_P product_j epsilon_j^a_j.

The joint-eigenspace projector has trace 2^(n-r)>0; extend its signed isotropic Pauli span to a rank-n stabilizer. Maximality makes every measured coordinate outside S anticommute with an element of S and hence vanish.

Resolve a maximal commuting extension of the nonzero measured support into its joint eigenspace projectors. Born weights reproduce all coordinates in S, while both the original projection and every v_(S,f) vanish outside S.

The convex-hull equality implication from candidate physicality and projected-atom refinement is Lean-kernel checked. The separate saturated-coordinate extremality argument is still an open declaration and is not inherited from that implication.
